rule: external research is inspiration/evidence candidate, never runtime authority or automatic promotion

sources.title: EvolveNet: Collaborative Harness Evolution for Agent Self-Improvement
sources.pattern: distributed/data-local harness evolution; move experience extraction to data-local agents
sources.action: shadow-test local experience extraction and mergeable improvement proposals; no self-promotion

sources.title: PAST-Bench: Benchmarking the Foundations of Recursive Self-Improvement in Personal Agents
sources.pattern: matched fresh-session tasks with memory on/off; test whether retained experience improves later behavior
sources.action: add memory-on/off longitudinal evaluation and save/retrieve/update pathway metrics

sources.title: AgentCL: Toward Rigorous Evaluation of Continual Learning in Language Agents
sources.pattern: controlled task streams, transfer gains and interference-aware continual-learning evaluation
sources.action: measure transfer gain, forgetting/interference and relevance of promoted experience

sources.title: Ask the World Before Acting: Environment Probing for Calibrated Agent World Models
sources.pattern: budgeted pre-action probing using criticality, staleness, uncertainty and dependency role
sources.action: add entropy/staleness/criticality probe policy before high-risk action

sources.title: Repair the Amplifier, Not the Symptom: Stable World-Model Correction for Agent Rollouts
sources.pattern: repair compact failure-amplifying world-model subgraphs instead of only visible symptoms
sources.action: test subgraph failure attribution, correction and rollback on failed rollouts

sources.title: Contextual Experience Replay for Self-Improvement of Language Agents
sources.pattern: training-free dynamic experience buffer with contextual retrieval for self-improvement
sources.action: shadow-test scoped experience replay with interference and provenance gates

sources.title: GATS: Graph-Augmented Tree Search with Layered World Models for Efficient Agent Planning
sources.pattern: layered world model: symbolic action matching, execution statistics and LLM prediction for unknown actions
sources.action: benchmark layered planning against current planner for quality, latency and cost
